pairs.difference: Both are rich geniuses with no superpowers. Batman is DC, dark and works at night; Iron Man is Marvel, wisecracking, in a red-and-gold suit.
Both fly, wear capes and have a mild alter ego. Superman is American (Clark Kent); Shaktimaan is Indian (Gangadhar), and spins as he takes off.
Shinchan is a cheeky five-year-old who embarrasses his mum; Nobita is a lazy schoolboy rescued by Doraemon's gadgets.
Sherlock Holmes is a detective who solves crimes by deduction; James Bond is a spy with gadgets, guns and cars.
Gabbar is a dacoit in Sholay ("Kitne aadmi the?"); Mogambo is a supervillain in Mr. India ("Mogambo khush hua").
Gandalf is a grey-robed wizard with a staff from Lord of the Rings; Dumbledore is the Hogwarts headmaster with half-moon glasses.
Motu is fat, strong and loves samosas; Patlu is thin and has the clever ideas.
Garfield is an orange, lazy cat who loves lasagne; Oggy is a blue cat tormented by cockroaches.
Scooby-Doo is a talking, scaredy Great Dane who solves mysteries; Pluto is Mickey's silent pet dog.
Jack Sparrow is a swaggering pirate with a compass; Captain Hook has a hook hand and fears a crocodile.
Krrish is Indian, masked and jumps huge distances; Spider-Man is American and swings on webs.
The Joker is Batman's laughing clown villain; Thanos is the purple Titan with the gauntlet who snaps half the universe away.
Hulk is green and smashes; Thor is a god with a hammer and lightning.
Doraemon is a blue robot cat with gadgets from the future; Chhota Bheem is a strong boy in Dholakpur who loves ladoos.
Mario is a plumber who jumps on mushrooms; Pac-Man is a yellow circle eating dots and fleeing ghosts.
Elsa has ice powers; Cinderella loses a glass slipper at midnight.
Snow White has the seven dwarfs and a poisoned apple; Rapunzel has very long hair and a tower.
Peter Pan is a boy who flies and never grows up; Pinocchio is a wooden puppet whose nose grows when he lies.
Captain America carries a star shield; Wonder Woman is an Amazon warrior with a golden lasso.
Wolverine has metal claws and is grumpy; Deadpool wears a red suit and cracks jokes to the audience.
Dracula is a vampire who drinks blood; Frankenstein's monster is stitched together and brought to life by electricity.
Tarzan is raised by apes and swings on vines; Mowgli is raised by wolves, with Baloo and Sher Khan.
Darth Vader is the masked Star Wars villain with a red lightsaber; Optimus Prime is the heroic Transformers truck-robot.
Pikachu is a yellow electric Pokémon; Sonic is a blue, super-fast hedgehog.
Popeye is a sailor who eats spinach for strength; Bugs Bunny is a rabbit with a carrot ("What's up, doc?").
Minions are yellow, wear goggles and love bananas; Smurfs are blue and live in mushroom houses.
Ben 10 is a boy whose watch turns him into aliens; Johnny Bravo is a vain muscleman with a huge quiff.
Chacha Chaudhary is the comic-book old man whose brain works faster than a computer; Tenali Raman is the witty poet from a king's court.
Singham is the roaring, honest cop from Goa; Chulbul Pandey is the swaggering cop with sunglasses tucked in his collar.
